stem.text: Which structure best represents the species in the vapour at this temperature?

A.alt: Al2Cl6 dimer: two Al atoms, each with two terminal Cl and two bridging Cl, drawn with arrows on the bridging bonds (option A).

B.alt: Al2Cl6 dimer: two Al atoms, each with two terminal Cl and two bridging Cl, drawn with arrows on the bridging bonds (option B).

C.alt: AlCl3 drawn as a trigonal structure with Al in the centre and three Cl atoms (option C).

D.alt: Al3+(Cl-)3 formula with superscript 3+ on Al and superscript minus on Cl (option D).
